issue.title: Smoke test fail with "Could not find page" error

repository.name: streamlit-app-action

issue.body:
When running the Github actions page smoke test fails with this error message
```
Could not find page: `pages/x.py`. Must be the file path relative to the main script, from the directory: `pages`. Only the main app file and files in the `pages/` directory are supported.
```

This issue seems to happening with `st.page_link("pages/x.py")` call. It doesn't throw error with `st.switch_page`
I tried replacing `st.page_link("pages/x.py")` with `st.page_link("./pages/x.py")` but didn't fix the issue

There is no error with the streamlit application itself and this error does not get thrown. Only happen with when running the GitHub action workflow.

Might be related: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8070

body: I started looking into this, assuming it was going to be an issue with the hacky way I turn strings into relative paths, but I'm having trouble reproducing the error, as the "Fails" version works for me. The most suspect difference between my attempt and what you report is that I tested it on linux. I will see if I can reproduce it on macOS directly.

It apparently works for me on `1.31.1`, but fails with the expected error on `1.31.0`. I know we had several bug fixes for `page_link` in the patch, so it seems like this issue was fixed incidentally. I'm going to assume this is resolved, but please reopen if you are still having this issue on `1.31.1` or later.

The error still occur on `1.31.1`. For me the error happen when running the GitHub action workflow.
Link to the corresponding failed GitHub Action run for reference:
https://github.com/s4021245/streamlit-gh-action-test/actions/runs/8013304706/job/21890126718

I was able to investigate this using your `streamlit-gh-action-test` repo and a Streamlit wheel with more detailed error messages. I believe the problem during the smoke test is because it tries to run each page independently as an app test. If you run `streamlit run pages/page_1.py` in that repo the same error will occur, because it sees `pages` as the main directory.

This doesn't seem like a bug with `AppTest` exactly, but we could potentially support switching pages in AppTest better so the smoke test could use that instead of the current approach.
